welcome.title: Welcome to Washstore! 👋
welcome.text: We'll guide you through how to use the machines.

step1.title: Step 1: Choose a Service
step1.instruction: Tap the service card to continue.

step2.title: Step 2: Select a Machine
step2.instruction: Choose an available machine and tap it.

step3.title: Step 3: Pick a Program
step3.instruction: Select the program that best suits your needs.

step4.title: Step 4: Shopping Cart 🛒
step4.instruction: Tap the cart icon to view your items.

step5.title: Step 5: Payment 💳
step5.note: ⚠️ Card top-ups are only available via Cash.

card.title: Loyalty Card 💎
card.text: Tap the card icon in the top menu to view balance, history and top-up the card.

done.title: You're Ready! 🎉
done.text: You now know how to use Washstore.
done.note: If you need help again, tap the ? icon in the menu.
